tour.say: Starting just inside the front door, in the foyer. Hardwood parquet floor. The foyer is about 14 by 14 feet. The stairs are ahead on your left.
The living room doorway is on your left.
Living room. About 14 by 19 feet, carpet. The windows face the street, behind you. A wide opening ahead leads to the formal dining room.
Formal dining room. About 14 by 13 feet, carpet. Windows on the back wall ahead. A doorway on your right leads to the kitchen.
Kitchen. About 14 by 13 feet, tile. The listing says the appliances, counters, and backsplash are new. The kitchen flows straight into the dining area on your right.
Dining area, tile. There's no wall here. It opens into the family room on your right.
Family room. About 23 by 14 feet, carpet, with a fireplace on the right wall. The door to the screened porch is ahead.
Screened porch. About 17 by 11 feet, with a deck floor and screens on three sides.
Back through the kitchen, into the back of the foyer. The half bath is on your right.
The laundry room is on your right.
Laundry room, about 9 by 9 feet. A door on your right leads to the garage.
Garage. An oversized two car garage, about 21 by 24 feet, concrete. The big garage door is behind you.
Stairs to the second floor. Carpeted, with a turn partway up.
Top of the stairs. Upstairs hall, carpet. The hall bath is ahead on your right, and the primary bedroom door is straight ahead.
Primary bedroom. About 16 by 13 feet, carpet. Its own bathroom is through the door on your right.

Bedroom 3. About 14 by 17 feet, carpet, at the front corner of the house. That's the end of the tour. Explore on your own. Two finger tap asks where you are, and a triple tap points you to the front door.
